claims: In 2026, Apple TV+ is the exclusive home to all Formula 1 races, practices, and qualifying sessions in the United States.
Apple TV+ includes F1 TV Premium content.
Apple TV App is the primary, exclusive broadcaster for the 2026 Formula 1 season in the USA.
Apple TV+ costs $12.99/month or is included in Apple One bundles.
7-day free trials are available to new users.
Apple TV+ includes all 23+ races, F1 Sprint sessions, qualifying, and practice sessions, plus full race replays.
Sky Sports has Formula 1 rights in the UK.
M4 Sport has Formula 1 rights in Hungary.
Apple TV+ subscription is the official and exclusive channel for Formula 1 coverage in the USA in 2026
